reason: Continue implementation of the selected acceptance item until criteria pass.
criteria: Pinned, named fixture cases cover no change, removed operation, optional-to-required field, enum or constraint break, invalid specification, missing baseline, timeout or tool failure, and ignored or reclassified findings.
Each case materializes same-path base and candidate trees into a temporary local Git repository, creates an explicit baseline commit, and supplies its ref to the public scanner command.

Checked-in expected reports validate against report schema 0.3; findings assert all required OpenAPI fields, while error cases assert exact diagnostic IDs, no corresponding policy finding, inconclusive status, and exit 2.
Execution-path cases use only controlled local substitutes and assert the argv profile, disabled external references, read-only temporary inputs, fixed timeout, and both output limits.
Every fixture is run twice; both canonical outputs match its checked-in expected bytes, and test execution never rewrites expected artifacts.
`cd scanner && uv run --locked pytest tests/openapi/test_fixture_matrix.py` and `cd scanner && uv run --locked pytest` pass.
`cd scanner && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked mypy` passes.
